thread:
mia_marketing: Heads-up: SDRs reported 7 EU leads routed to NA this morning around 08:18 UTC. Looks like enrichment lag + RR fallback.
oz_revops: Same pattern as before. HubSpot sends initial create, then enrichment updates country. Router assigns on create -> wrong pool.
raja_eng: Quick mitigation idea: make router idempotent + add tiny hold window (500ms) for contacts created with source=form. If country missing after window, infer from IP and mark inferred=true.
kelly_sdrlead: Sub-second is fine. SDRs prefer accurate routing > instant. 500ms OK.
mia_marketing: Can marketing add a hidden country_hint on webforms? Low lift.
oz_revops: Yes, we'll add country_hint to forms, but keep server-side guard. Also add HS workflow to set "assignment_ready" = true after enrichment step.
raja_eng: Router pseudo-config:
```
round_robin: {
  hold_ms: 500,
  bucket_by: country_or_inferred,
  fallback_queue: overflow_pool
}
```
raja_eng: I'll put behind feature flag router.hold_guard. Can we canary at 15:00 UTC?
oz_revops: Sounds good. Also add metric lead.assign_unknown_pct and assign_idempotent_hits.
kelly_sdrlead: I'll tell SDRs to watch overflow_pool and flag any NA misroutes.
hs-bot: hubspot-bot: Workflow inbound-enrich updated: set assignment_ready=true (wf id wf_9123).
raja_eng: Canary started by deploy-bot at 2025-01-08T15:00:05Z (build 2025.01.08.12). Early staging: assign_unknown_pct down 2.4% -> 0.3%.
oz_revops: Good signal. Rollout plan: 1) canary 15:00, 2) monitor 30m, 3) promote if overflow_pool < 20 and assign_unknown_pct < 0.5%.
mia_marketing: I'll post a quick note for SDRs and add a playbook entry for inferred_country leads. Closing after 24h stable.
